subject: Request: in-country audit & constrained maintenance access for EU pilot
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medilink.eu>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@medilink.eu>, Procurements <procurements@medilink.eu>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:03:00+02:00
Subject: Audit access & hosting constraints for EU pilot

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency and the telemetry. We are preparing a 3-month EU pilot (PHI scope) and need to confirm a few hosting/audit items before procurement can sign: 

- In-country audit access: Medilink auditors need to perform an on-site or in-country technical audit during the pilot. We can give 3 business days notice.
- Maintenance/connectivity: we require maintenance access to a bastion/jumpbox during a scheduled window; no direct console access to customer data.
- Key management: we cannot allow Redwood to export keys outside the EU for the pilot; preferred: customer-managed keys where possible.
- Audit frequency: procurement prefers a single annual audit but our security team requested quarterly checks for the first year.

We also have budget constraints for pilots and are asking if Redwood can provide a 25% pilot discount or a one-time onboarding credit to cover audit costs. Attached is the audit request and a proposed mutual action plan.

Can you confirm what is feasible and whether any of this requires executive sign-off? Procurement would like a written confirmation this week to keep our timeline.

Regards,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security Programs
Medilink Health

Attachments: Medilink_Audit_Request_v2.pdf (pdf), MutualActionPlan.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medilink.eu>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@medilink.eu>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:18:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Audit access & hosting constraints for EU pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and attaching the MAP. Short answers up front: we can support in-country audits and constrained maintenance access, and customer-managed keys in the EU for the pilot. A few items (audit cadence and the 25% pilot discount) will require internal approvals.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in our deal owner and security lead to confirm exact boundary conditions (no key export, jumpbox-only maintenance, approved audit windows).
- If you can pick 2 potential audit weeks in October, we’ll confirm schedule availability.

I’m copying internal colleagues for a quick internal review. I’ll follow up shortly with an escalation for approvals if needed.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: 2027-09-16T08:42:00+02:00
Subject: Fwd: Audit access & hosting constraints for Medilink EU pilot — request for exec sign-off

Vivek, Laura — forwarding Medilink’s ask. Key points we need a decision on for the deal (DF-2027-042):

Summary of external asks (attached MAP + audit request):
- In-country audit capability (Medilink auditors, 3 business days notice).
- Maintenance access limited to a bastion/jumpbox during scheduled windows (no direct node SSH).
- Customer-managed keys required; no export of keys outside EU for the pilot.
- Audit cadence: external asks annual; security wants quarterly for year one.
- Commercial: 25% pilot discount OR a one-time onboarding credit to help pay for audits.

My read: we can honor the hosting controls + key constraints for a time-limited pilot if Legal signs a Mutual Access Plan that limits scope and confirms Redwood won’t be required to change KMS custody. The audit cadence is the sticky item — quarterly audit increases ops burden and risk.

Specific asks to you both:
1) Approve a pilot concession: allow in-country audits with 3 business days notice, access limited to monitored jumpbox only (no customer data export).
2) Approve customer-managed keys in the EU for pilot (no key export).
3) Commercial approval request: approve up to a 20% pilot discount and a one-time onboarding credit of $15k OR escalate to 25% discount if both Legal and Finance sign off.
4) If you approve, confirm whether we need any SLA carveouts (e.g., extended maintenance windows) or additional indemnities.

I’ve attached the MAP and the audit request for context. If we can get a decision today/early tomorrow, I can commit to Medilink’s procurement timeline.

Thanks —
Logan

Attachments: Medilink_Audit_Request_v2.pdf, MutualActionPlan.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T10:11:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit access & hosting constraints for Medilink EU pilot — request for exec sign-off

Thanks Logan — quick thoughts:

- In-country audit + jumpbox-only maintenance: operationally acceptable for a timeboxed pilot provided Legal signs an MoP that scopes access and limits PII exposure.
- Customer-managed keys in EU: OK for pilot, but we must confirm compatibility with our telemetry and crash reporting (no plaintext key material leaves customer boundary). Engineering should confirm impact on observability.
- Audit cadence: I’m reluctant to approve quarterly audits. I’ll sign off on annual audits for the pilot; Security team can require a technical attestation (remediation evidence) at mid-pilot if needed. Quarterly is too high-touch for a pilot and risks SLA churn.
- Commercial: I can approve a 20% pilot discount + $10k onboarding credit immediately. If Finance wants to push to 25% we need an exec-level sign-off and a written trade-off (long-term ARR commitment or larger renewal discount).

If Laura is ok with the commercial terms and Legal/Eng confirm the KMS/telemetry impact, I’m fine to proceed.

Vivek
CTO (acting on deal exceptions)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-17T09:37:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit access & hosting constraints for Medilink EU pilot — request for exec sign-off

Logan/Vivek — after a quick sync with Legal and Finance:

Decision (conditional exec approval):
- Approve in-country audit access for the pilot, limited to 3 business days notice, and access strictly via a monitored jumpbox. Legal will provide an MoP template that scops measurements and excludes any request for key custody changes.
- Approve customer-managed keys (EU-only) for the pilot, provided Engineering confirms telemetry remains functional without key export. Legal will add a clause that prevents any requirement to move keys off-prem during/after the pilot.
- Audit cadence: we will not accept quarterly audits. Approve annual audit for the pilot; require a technical attestation at midpoint (30–45 days) to demonstrate remediation posture.
- Commercial: approve a 20% pilot discount plus a one-time onboarding credit of $12,500 to be applied at contract execution. If Medilink can commit to a 12-month paid renewal at pilot completion, we will consider a retroactive additional credit up to 5%.

Conditions that must be met before signature:
- Signed Mutual Access Plan (Legal to redline) attached to the SOW.
- Engineering confirmation on telemetry/KMS compatibility (please loop Eng Ops).
- Procurement to acknowledge audit window limits and the attestation cadence.

Logan — you have my conditional sign-off. Please capture these terms in a succinct concession memo for Deal Desk and attach redlined MAP. Copy Finance/Legal when sending to Medilink.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medilink.eu>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <m.bianchi@medilink.eu>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T16:21:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Audit access & hosting constraints for EU pilot — confirmed terms and next steps

Hi Elena / Marco,

Thanks for your patience — internal approvals confirmed with the conditions below. We can proceed on the following terms for the 3-month EU pilot (Deal DF-2027-042):

1) Hosting & audit access
- Medilink auditors are permitted in-country audits with 3 business days notice. Access will be limited to a monitored jumpbox only; no direct console or node-level SSH to systems containing customer PII.

2) Key management
- Customer-managed keys in the EU are allowed for the pilot. Redwood will not export or hold key material outside the EU for this pilot. Engineering will confirm that telemetry and crash reports function with this KMS configuration.

3) Audit cadence
- Annual formal audit for the pilot. Additionally, Medilink will receive a mid-pilot technical attestation (30–45 days) summarizing remediation evidence. Quarterly audits are not approved.

4) Commercial concessions
- Redwood will provide a 20% pilot discount plus a one-time onboarding credit of $12,500 applied at contract signing. If Medilink signs a 12-month paid renewal at pilot completion, we will evaluate a retroactive additional credit up to 5%.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the redlined Mutual Access Plan (Legal_MoP_Redline.docx) and a short concession memo for Deal Desk.
- Please confirm two potential audit weeks in October and sign the MOP so Legal can finalize the SOW.
- I will share a DocuSign link for the SOW and discount addendum once we have confirmation on the audit week and Engineering’s KMS check.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
Attachments referenced: Legal_MoP_Redline.docx (docx), Concession_Memo_DF-2027-042.pdf (pdf)

Best regards,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
